profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ The Home Depot | USAF Veteran
profile.summary:
Key Traits - Effective Leadership, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Policy Development, Program Execution, Innovation, Strategic Planning, Operational Risk Management, Human Capital, Team Building, Project Management, Resource Management, Situational Awareness

- I am a dedicated problem solver who continuously seeks out solutions.  23+ years of military aviation experience.  I enjoy helping people and communities with my available skillsets.  

- I view myself as being adaptive, using intelligent process analysis for direct execution.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Excited for my new role of Software Engineer, will also be dabbling in Systems Engineering and learning as much as possible
positions.insights: Terraform, Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and +3 skills

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
- Attended 4th ever DoD Software Development Immersive ( 12-wk full-time Full-Stack Bootcamp ), 1st person from Travis AFB.
- Currently working on BASE app for USAF ( Airspace Scheduling App )

positions.title: Evaluations Manager
positions.description:
- Led the Evaluation and Standards office
- Senior most Flight Engineer Evaluator responsible for providing flight evaluations to 7 Evaluators
- Directs and implements policy within the organization
- Communicates trends with leadership

positions.title: Flight Engineer Instructor
positions.description:
- Certified flight instructor, shaping the Air Force's future C-5M Super Galaxy Flight Engineers
- Instructs new Flight Engineers in the classroom and in the air
- Provides feedback to the training shop

positions.title: E-3A Instructor Flight Engineer
positions.description:
- 3.5 yrs working for NATO in Germany
- Developed increased communication skills working within the European Community (15 nations)
- Was able to instruct foreign NATO members in flight under stressful conditions

positions.title: C-5B/M Test Evaluator Flight Engineer
positions.description:
- Acceptance Check Flights on C-5M
- Dual qualified evaluator on C-5B and C-5M
- Performed first flight test flights on non-airworthy aircraft and certified them for flight/delivery
- Immersed in acquisitions throughout the government contracting process

honors.title: Sigma Beta Delta
honors.description: Received Sigma Beta Delta honor for 4.0 GPA, which I continued through graduation.
honors.issuer: Issued by Sigma Beta Delta · Apr 2015

projects.title: C-5M Electronic Takeoff and Landing Data Program
projects.description: I created and employed the first Air Force approved (December 2014) electronic takeoff and landing data program for the C-5M.  My program was utilized on every C-5M flight around the globe for over 6 years.  I have continuously updated and refreshed this program to its current state.
